'''The Narrows''' was a narrow portion of the [[Mephyt River|Krisa River]] valley, located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. The Narrows separated the city of [[Nashal]] from the rest of the valley. It was used as a racetrack for the [[Nashal River Race]].<ref name="SWG:NRT" />
